description: The native cold-start round (cpp/update_flow_core/native_round.h), shared by the Android, iOS and Harmony orchestrators and replayed by scripts/test-update-flow-core.sh. `prepare`: config text + env + sample -> PrepareRound ({body (compared as an object), query}; no `expected` = Undefined). `query`: the requests a NextQueryStep walk issues against the scripted `responses` (url -> text; a missing url is a failed request) and the response it settles on. `respond`: HandleRoundResponse. `before` records what each platform's own orchestrator did where they disagreed before this core replaced them; the expected value is the JS-equivalent or strictest of them. Hand-maintained.

prepare.name: typical round
the sample picks the first endpoint
no packageVersion override uses the binary's
an empty packageVersion uses the binary's
a non-string packageVersion uses the binary's
no running version, Android form (null) is sent as null
no running version, iOS form (absent) is left out
no running version, Harmony form ("") is sent as ""
absent rnu/rn are sent as ""
non-string rnu/rn are sent as ""
no uuid is sent as ""
no bundleHash is left out
an empty bundleHash is left out
no buildTime is left out
one http endpoint turns https-only off
a non-string endpoint turns https-only off and is kept for the walk
non-array endpoints and queryUrls read as empty

before.harmony: no request at all (the ordering binding rejected a non-array); a string queryUrls was walked per character

prepare.name: a disabled config prepares nothing
an invalid config prepares nothing
an env that is not an object prepares nothing

query.name: falls back through configured endpoints, deduped by normalized base
an invalid response does not stop the fallback
the appKey is trimmed in the URL
the sample decides which endpoint goes first
discovers remote endpoints, skipping tried, non-string and cleartext ones

before.android: 42 was coerced to "42" and dropped as non-https

query.name: cleartext remote endpoints are allowed without an https-only config
only the first parsable remote list is used
a failed list fetch moves on to the next list
a remote list must be strict JSON

before.android: org.json accepted the single-quoted list and queried https://x

query.name: stops after 8 HTTP requests, list fetches included
non-string configured endpoints are skipped without spending a request

before.harmony: the round threw (normalizeEndpointBase on a number) and failed internal_error

query.name: non-string and empty queryUrls entries are skipped without spending a request

before.android: fetched "7" first (optString coerces), spending a request
before.harmony: spent a request on 7 (the fetch failed), then the same

query.name: non-array endpoints still try the list discovery
no endpoints and no lists issue no request

respond.name: up to date
a download drops cleartext artifact URLs under an https-only config
cleartext artifact URLs are kept without an https-only config
no running version (null) drops the diff attempt
no running version (absent) drops the diff attempt
no running version ("") drops the diff attempt
only cleartext mirrors under https-only leave no attempt
forceBoot activates and marks the rescue
a truthy forceBoot 1 marks the rescue it activates

before.android: activated without the marker (optBoolean(1) is false)

respond.name: a truthy forceBoot "false" marks the rescue it activates

before.android: activated without the marker (optBoolean("false") is false)

respond.name: a falsy forceBoot neither activates nor marks
the silent strategy activates without marking a rescue
a non-string afterDownload never activates

before.harmony: the binding rejected the number: failed invalid_response, no cache

respond.name: only string name/description/metaInfo are kept
the launch's rolled-back version is never downloaded again
the running version is already current
the packageVersion override keys the gray release
the cache keeps every text verbatim
an invalid config handles nothing
an env that is not an object handles nothing
